dedupe_keys.name: twinspectra refuse derived fuel particle reflectance measurements

description: TwinSpectra contains reflectance measurements of refuse-derived fuel particles sampled in a cement-manufacturing context. Ruhr University Bochum and Opole University of Technology researchers measured 120 samples in six particle groups with two spectroradiometers. The current Zenodo version lists two CSV files containing 718 and 720 labelled measurements, plus two Jupyter notebooks for preview and a baseline classifier. One device covers 350–2,500 nanometres and the other 908.1–1,676.2 nanometres. The deposit is open under CC BY 4.0 and free. Coverage is sampled fuel particles and two laboratory measurement sessions, not a continuous cement-kiln feed or a plant-wide energy balance. Limitations include spectral-device differences, particle sampling and group labels when transferring to new waste streams; no classification accuracy was reproduced. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating feedstock-sorting or fuel-quality modules in waste-to-energy and cement-process simulations. model-east-java-rdf-cement-system-dynamics is related at plant-policy scale, without a verified data connection. No CSV, notebook or article PDF was downloaded.
